name: extra300-meigs
description: Extra 300L flight simulation for Arrival.Space, starting at Chicago's Meigs Field (CGX)

scripts.model: ${BPY:-python3} scripts/blender/extra300l.py data/model/extra300l.json --glb dist/extra300l.glb --blend dist/extra300l.blend && node scripts/bake-model.mjs extra300l
scripts.model:f15: ${BPY:-python3} scripts/blender/f15c.py data/model/f15c.json --glb dist/f15c.glb --blend dist/f15c.blend && node scripts/bake-model.mjs f15c
scripts.model:xwing: ${BPY:-python3} scripts/blender/xwing.py data/model/xwing.json --glb dist/xwing.glb --blend dist/xwing.blend && node scripts/bake-model.mjs xwing
scripts.model:b777: ${BPY:-python3} scripts/blender/b777.py data/model/b777.json --glb dist/b777.glb --blend dist/b777.blend && node scripts/bake-model.mjs b777
